main_text.l: תל Ch. Cumulus, Agger.
תליל Ch. Cumulatum, accumulatum, aggestum, ele-
vatum, excelsum, excellens, Psalm. 8.1.10. Plural. קרּיּן
תלילין Urbes munitæ, Exo.1.11. Jon.Numer.32.17.
in T.Hierof. emph. תלילא Deuter.28.52. in Jon. Foe-
min. תלילן, Deuter.3.5. in T.Hierosol.
ܠܚܡܐ Syr. Humor, Lucæ 8.6.
תלם תלמא Ch. Porca agri, Sulcus, Job.39.10. Plur.
תלמין תלמין Gen.49.4. in T.Jon. & Hierof. quod an
huj9 significationis sit, dubito. Elias scripsit se igno-
rare quid sit. Cum aff. תלמיהא Porcas ejus, Jobi
31. 38. Hinc nomé proprium ܒܪܬܘܠܡܝ Bartulmai,
Bartholomæus, quasi Filius sulcorum, seu Frumen-
tum sulcorum: non autem, Filius Ptolemæi, ut qui-
dam volunt.
ܠܡܐ Syr. Vide in למר.
תלע Ch. Findere, Diffindere, Levit.1.17. in
T.Hier. & Jonath.
תולעתא Ch. Vermis, vermiculus: Syr. ܬܘܠܥܬܐ, Mar.
9.43.45.47. Plur. ܬܘܠܥܐ Vermes, Act.12.23.
* תלעב Pahel Ch. Subsannavit, Illusit, irrisit: Insani-
vit. Idem quod אתלעב, unde forte per pravam pun-
ctationem ortum.
תלש תליש Ch. Avellere, evellere, divellere, dis-
rumpere, exstirpare, eradicare, putare, amp-
utare. Ithpeh אתלש Evelli, eradicari, excindi.
תליש Ch. Avulsum, evulsum, divulsum, dilaceratum.
תלת

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are reproduced as best legible; Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain and may be imperfect. The final word תלת stands alone at the lower right.
